title: Show an owner with pets and visits
summary: The owner details page (/owners/details/:ownerId) makes one call to the gateway controller, which reads the owner and pets from customers-service and then all the pets' visits from visits-service, and merges them.

steps.label: Load owner details
steps.description: OwnerDetailsPage requests the aggregated owner. This path is a controller in the gateway, not a proxy route.

steps.label: Fetch owner and pets
steps.description: The gateway calls customers-service by service name.

steps.label: Load owner with pets
steps.description: The Owner entity loads its pets eagerly.

steps.label: Owner with pets
steps.description: The gateway reads it into its own OwnerDetails record (whose pet type keeps only the name); the pets' visits list starts empty.

steps.label: Fetch visits for all the owner's pets
steps.description: After the owner arrives the gateway joins the pet ids with commas and makes one call, wrapped in a circuit breaker; if it fails, an empty visits list is used. The gateway's only time limit is a 10-second default for its circuit breakers; this breaker uses it, so a slow visits service gives the same empty list, with no error on the page.

steps.label: Visits
steps.description: Visits wrapped in an items array.

steps.label: Attach visits to each pet
steps.description: Each pet gets the visits whose petId equals the pet's id.

steps.label: Owner with pets and visits
steps.description: The page renders owner fields, a row per pet and the pet's visits.

tests.name: ApiGatewayControllerTest.getOwnerDetails_withAvailableVisitsService
tests.why: Calls GET /api/gateway/owners/1 with customers and visits clients mocked

tests.name: ApiGatewayControllerTest.getOwnerDetails_withServiceError
tests.why: Visits call fails and the owner is still returned

title: Add a visit for a pet
summary: The visits page form posts to /api/visit/.... The gateway forwards it by route (no gateway controller code) to visits-service, which saves it.

steps.label: Submit the new visit form
steps.description: VisitsPage (route /owners/:ownerId/pets/:petId/visits) posts the form, then navigates back to the owner details page.

steps.label: Forward by route, /api/visit prefix stripped
steps.description: A Spring Cloud Gateway route matches /api/visit/** and sends it to the visits-service instance found through the load balancer. A default Retry filter retries a POST once on 503.

steps.label: Insert the visit (petId taken from the URL)
steps.description: The handler overwrites petId with the path value and saves the Visit entity.

steps.label: 201 Created with the saved visit
steps.description: Date is serialised as yyyy-MM-dd.

title: Service startup
summary: How customers-service starts in docker-compose: the config server comes up first, then the service imports its configuration (served from the config repo), registers with Eureka, and the gateway later resolves lb://customers-service.

steps.label: Config server starts and becomes healthy
steps.description: Port 8888; its compose healthcheck curls http://config-server:8888 (10 retries every 5s). Because the image runs with the docker profile and the native profile is not enabled, the git uri backend is the one configured.

steps.label: Discovery server starts after config-server is healthy
steps.description: depends_on config-server with condition service_healthy; its own healthcheck curls port 8761.

steps.label: Wait for config-server and discovery-server to be healthy
steps.description: depends_on lists both with service_healthy; the container then starts with the docker profile (port 8081).

steps.label: Import configuration for customers-service
steps.description: spring.config.import in the docker profile is configserver:http://config-server:8888; outside docker it is optional:configserver:${CONFIG_SERVER_URL:http://localhost:8888/}. spring.application.name is customers-service.

steps.label: Read config files from the git backend
steps.description: The git uri points at the spring-petclinic-microservices-config repository, default label main. The repo holds application.yml (shared) and customers-service.yml.

steps.label: Shared and per-service YAML
steps.description: Shared application.yml sets random port 0 and the docker-profile zipkin endpoint; customers-service.yml has a docker-profile block with port 8081 and the Eureka defaultZone.

steps.label: Configuration properties
steps.description: customers-service now has server.port 8081, eureka.client.serviceUrl.defaultZone and the zipkin endpoint from the config repo.

steps.label: Register with Eureka as customers-service
steps.description: Eureka client enabled by @EnableDiscoveryClient; the registry URL is the defaultZone from the config repo.

steps.label: Fetch the registry to resolve lb://customers-service
steps.description: A gateway route for Path=/api/customer/** has target uri lb://customers-service; the gateway is a discovery client with a load-balanced client, which resolves the name to a registered instance.

title: List veterinarians
summary: The Veterinarians page asks the gateway for /api/vet/vets; the gateway forwards /vets to vets-service, which reads all vets from its database.

tests.name: VetResourceTest
tests.why: Checks GET /vets returns 200 with the vet id

title: Chat with the assistant
tagline: Chat box to LLM and back
summary: The chat box posts the message as a JSON string to the gateway; genai-service passes it to the LLM, which may call tools (for example one that lists owners from customers-service).

steps.label: Route, prefix stripped
steps.description: The default CircuitBreaker filter (fallback forward:/fallback) applies to every route, and this route adds its own genaiCircuitBreaker (fallback /fallback); how the two combine is gateway behaviour not read here. The only time limit configured is the 10-second default, so a slower LLM answer ends in the 503 from /fallback, which the chat box shows as its own "Chat is currently unavailable" message.

steps.label: Prompt with system text and tools
Example tool call: list owners (direct, via Eureka)
Answer as a plain string (error text on failure)

evidence.quote: Chat is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

title: Register or edit an owner
summary: The Register owner and Edit Owner pages use one form component. A new owner is POSTed, an existing one PUT, both through the gateway route /api/customer/** to customers-service.

steps.label: Submit the new owner form
steps.description: Opened from the "Register owner" menu entry (route /owners/new). The telephone field only accepts up to 12 digits.

steps.label: Forward by route, /api/customer prefix stripped
steps.description: All five fields must be non-blank and the telephone at most 12 digits, or the request is rejected. The gateway is configured with a default Retry filter for POST on 503 (retries: 1).

steps.label: Insert the owner
steps.description: The request is copied onto a new Owner entity and saved.

steps.label: 201 Created with the saved owner
steps.description: The route returns the owner JSON to the browser.

steps.label: 201, then back to the owners list
steps.description: The page ignores the body and navigates to the owners list.

steps.label: Submit the edit owner form
steps.description: The Edit Owner button on the owner details page opens /owners/:ownerId/edit, which first loads the current values with GET /api/customer/owners/{ownerId} and then sends the same five fields. (The response steps of the pre-load calls are left out.)

steps.label: Load the owner and save the changes
steps.description: An unknown owner id ends in a not-found error and nothing is saved.

steps.label: 204, then back to the owner details page

title: Add or edit a pet
summary: From the owner details page, Add New Pet and the pet's Edit Pet link open one pet form. Both go through /api/customer/** to customers-service, which attaches the pet to its owner.

steps.label: Load the pet types for the form
steps.description: Add New Pet (route /owners/:ownerId/new-pet) also loads the owner to show the name: GET /api/customer/owners/{ownerId}.

steps.label: Submit the new pet form
steps.description: The form sends the pet type as an id, not a name.

steps.label: Forward by route, prefix stripped
steps.description: A birth date in the future is rejected with 400 (bean validation). The gateway is configured with a default Retry filter for POST on 503 (retries: 1).

steps.label: Find the owner, add the pet, save
steps.description: An unknown owner id ends in a not-found error. The pet type id is looked up and set if it exists.

steps.label: 201 Created with the saved pet
steps.description: The owner is left out of the JSON.

steps.label: 201, then back to the owner details page
Open Edit Pet: load the pet
steps.description: The pet name on the owner details page links to /owners/:ownerId/pets/:petId, the same form in edit mode. Edit mode first loads /petTypes (as above), then the pet; the browser-side responses of these loads are left out.

steps.label: Forward by route, prefix stripped
steps.description: The gateway strips /api/customer and forwards the real owner id; * is the Spring mapping pattern, so the owner id is not used and the pet is found by its own id.

steps.label: Pet with its owner's name
steps.description: The owner is a single string, first and last name.

steps.label: Forward by route, prefix stripped
steps.description: The owner id in the path is a wildcard and is not used; the pet is found by its own id.

steps.label: Load the pet and save the changes
steps.description: An unknown pet id ends in a not-found error and nothing is saved.

steps.label: 204, then back to the owner details page
